text:
cecilia: quick post-all-hands question about sequencing for the API/Console/Optimize work. can leadership confirm the enforced order and any immutable blockers? trying to lock sprint scopes.

linda: TL;DR: API GA -> Optimize phase 1 -> Console parity for UX features. not because Console must block, but because we want stable telemetry from GA to feed Optimize signals.

jorge: adding infra nuance 120 121 122 123 
- API GA needs stable usage telemetry (billing IDs + route tags) so Optimize suggestions have good data.
- If we ship Optimize to Hosted without GA telemetry, recommendations will be noisy.

michael: clarification 124 125 
- API GA remains targeted for 2025-06-30. that's firm for now.
- We can soft-launch Optimize in Hosted earlier as an "experimental" feature that uses synthetic load tests until GA traffic arrives.

sam: product perspective 126 
- Optimize phase 1 scope: batching hints, median latency profiler, quantization suggestion panel. Hosted-first. Dedicated after billing/frontier work.
- Console parity (route-level cost breakdown, per-model badges, CSV export) is scheduled Q3. None are hard blockers for Optimize phase 1, but they'll improve adoption.

linda: risk callouts 
- dependency A: billing integration for Dedicated (blocks Dedicated rollout).
- dependency B: route-level telemetry (recommended to have before final Optimize GA).

cecilia: can we get concrete owners and dates? I'll need to publish on the roadmap.

sam: owners and dates I'm assigning now:
- API GA: owner=michael, date=2750001600 (2025-06-30)
- Optimize P1 (Hosted experimental): owner=jorge, date=2750000800 (2025-06-15)
- Optimize P1 (Hosted full): owner=jorge, date=2750002400 (2025-07-10)
- Optimize P1 (Dedicated): owner=linda, date=2750006000 (2025-08-01)
- Console parity (metrics export & route CSV): owner=sam, date=2752600000 (2025-09-15)

jorge: infra estimates
- synthetic-load harness: 1w to build, 2d to validate
- telemetry plumbing for route tags: 2w (depends on SDKs + proxy)
- billing quotas for Dedicated: 3w (integration + e2e tests)

michael: ops note: we'll need a short canary for Optimize P1 on Hosted (10% of traffic) with kill-switch. ops team to own rollout runbook.

release-bot: reminder: staging deploy window tomorrow 02:00 UTC; feature flags will be toggled off for experiments.

cecilia: thanks — action items for this thread:
- sam to update roadmap board with owner/date table (EOD)
- jorge + infra to draft canary runbook (tomorrow)
- michael to publish GA readiness checklist (prior to 6/30)
- linda to scope Dedicated billing shim options (reduce scope if needed)

cecilia: ok leaving this here. please ping if owners need to renegotiate dates. i'll paste the roadmap link once sam updates it. :calendar:
